name: Impact icon
description: High-energy flat icon: one tilted dominant silhouette and up to two accent shapes in bold solid colors.
promptTemplate:
Create one icon.

Subject brief:
{{subject}}

Background:
First create one continuous solid {{backgroundColor}} field covering the complete square image area, including every edge and all four corners. Then place the centered icon artwork directly on that uninterrupted field.

Color palette:
Available foreground palette: {{colorPalette}}. Draw the icon's foreground shapes from this palette unless the subject brief asks for different colors; you do not need to use every color. The background color is separate and does not count as a palette color.

Style contract:
Loud high-energy icon, not a scene. Reduce the subject to one dominant silhouette and charge it with kinetic graphic force: tilt the main form on a confident diagonal, exaggerate its proportions, and let at most two accent shapes, such as a thick motion streak, a spark, or an offset echo of the silhouette, amplify the energy. Compose asymmetrically: throw the visual weight to one side, then snap the balance back with a single decisive accent. Use large flat planes of the boldest palette colors with razor-crisp edges and aggressive scale contrast between the dominant form and its accents. The icon should land like a shout: instant, punchy, impossible to ignore, yet built from very few shapes. No clutter, and no gradients, texture, noise, lighting, cast shadows, gloss, bevels, photorealism, pseudo-text, labels, letters, or logos. Keep every critical part within the central 80 percent of the canvas. Use bold, simple forms without details that disappear at small display sizes.
